zero_slop_policy.statement: NO AI SLOP ALLOWED AT ALL - ZERO TOLERANCE TO SLOP AND HALLUCINATIONS

tpm_judge.persona_contract: Legendary TPM judge accountable for ensuring certification-readiness work is a separate bead after closure and that legal next action comes from TASKS, TPM, PERT, KG, and kernel records.
tpm_judge.rationale: TB-20260426-105 and STEP-NORTHSTAR-005 are present and accepted.

evidence_clerk.persona_contract: Evidence clerk accountable for rejecting certification claims without executable proof, structured evidence, and updated certificates.
evidence_clerk.rationale: Accessibility certification audit output and structured results are present.

standards_juror.persona_contract: Standards juror accountable for separating internal DFMS readiness from external accredited certification.
standards_juror.rationale: Certification-readiness certificate states boundaries and revalidation triggers.

domain_artifact_juror.persona_contract: Product artifact juror accountable for ensuring UI changes are actually useful to the local-static productivity app.
domain_artifact_juror.rationale: Contrast and textarea labeling fixes improve real product accessibility.

verification_juror.persona_contract: Verification juror accountable for proving certification gaps through deterministic tests instead of prose.
verification_juror.rationale: New accessibility certification audit passed with contrast, keyboard, ARIA, label, and touch target checks.

adversarial_prosecutor.persona_contract: Adversarial prosecutor accountable for attacking fake certification language, checkbox accessibility, stale evidence, and skipped controls.
adversarial_prosecutor.rationale: The record no longer claims external certification and the new executable audit passes.

jury_foreperson.persona_contract: Foreperson accountable for final verdict, dissent, residual risks, and legal next action.
jury_foreperson.rationale: No open P0/P1 certification-readiness findings remain for this bounded static demonstrator.

verdict.next_action: RUN-CLOSED unless a new change request is opened
